denominatorBasis: Red Electrica reported in April 2025 that 189 charging infrastructure operators had been contacted for REVE integration; replace with the live /cpos count as soon as REVE authentication is restored or a complete current public inventory is recovered.

setAsideOperators.reason: Official Powerdot FAQ states exact charging prices vary by location, charging power and site-specific fees and instructs users to consult an EMSP for the exact charger tariff. Public station pages expose station identity, connectors and QR/payment methods but not the numeric tariff; the current Electroverse Spain subscription publishes only a percentage discount, not an absolute station price. No non-extrapolated public base tariff could be recovered.

Current official Telpark terms publish a 30% charging discount for eligible subscribers through 31 December 2026 but do not publish the underlying absolute charger price. Public parking pages identify charging availability but not connector-level energy tariffs, so applying the percentage without the base price would require extrapolation.

The official Spain public-charging page exposes station classes, availability, reservation, charging and payment through Mundo Galp, but no numeric EUR/kWh tariff is published on the public web surface. The exact charge amount is app/session based. Portugal Galp Electric tariffs are jurisdiction-specific and are not reused for Spain.

TotalEnergies confirms a physical Spanish network of more than 700 public points and Charge+/Charge Europe surfaces that expose prices in the app. The official web publishes a 10% Smart discount on TotalEnergies-operated points but not the underlying absolute EVSE tariff; partner points are mixed into the same mobility service. No exact public station/EVSE base price was recovered, so percentage discounts are not applied without the base tariff.

Official Iberdrola material states that public charging above included allowances is billed at the tariff in force at the specific charging point and directs users to the Movilidad Iberdrola app to locate, reserve and pay. No complete current public endpoint/table yielding that exact point tariff was recovered, so no network-wide price is inferred.

EDP Charge Spain officially exposes real-time location/status, charging, payment history and session control through the app, but the public official surface does not publish an exact numeric tariff table by station/EVSE. No reliable guest/public endpoint with exact tariffs was recovered in this pass, therefore EDP remains fail-closed.

Official BonpreuEsclat material publishes a temporary 0.19 EUR/kWh discount for energy customers at its store chargers through 31 December 2026, but does not state the underlying absolute public charger price on the official page. Third-party station pages repeatedly show 0.39 EUR/kWh, but that value is not promoted to an exact tariff without an official/public-primary confirmation; the discount is not back-solved into a base price.

Zunder.rule: Apply only to standard Zunder Spain EVSEs whose power/tariff class is positively established. Time-band, municipal/partner agreement and specific-location exceptions remain fail-closed until their exact station price is proven. Published ranges and 'from' prices are never used as exact tariffs.

Repsol.rule: Use only exact normal and ultra-fast Repsol-owned Spain tariffs. The fast-charge price is published as 'from 0.48 EUR/kWh' and therefore remains fail-closed rather than being extrapolated. Partner/roaming points and unresolved charge classes also remain unpriced.

Wenea.rule: Apply only to Wenea-owned Spain EVSEs in a positively established published power band. Partner/collaboration stations can vary and remain fail-closed. Wenea Everyday subscription prices are stored separately and only apply when that subscription is selected.

Eranovum.rule: Apply only to Eranovum Spain EVSEs whose power class is positively established; preserve any exact station-level price that differs from the country table. Occupancy penalties are stored separately and are not part of the base energy price.

EMT Madrid.rule: Apply only to EMT Madrid EVSEs whose official category is positively established. Preserve exact station-level prices for special hubs (including Canalejas) and leave unresolved/new hub categories fail-closed.

Plenergy (Plenoil).rule: Use 0.36 EUR/kWh only for exact station pages currently publishing the numeric charger price and matched by station identity. Do not generalize network-wide; pages with an empty charger price remain fail-closed.

ACCIONA.rule: Apply only to ACCIONA Spain EVSEs whose charger power is positively established: 0.35 EUR/kWh up to and including 22 kW, and 0.55 EUR/kWh above 22 kW. Unresolved station ownership, power, or location-specific exceptions remain fail-closed.

Endesa.rule: Apply only to positively identified Endesa public-network EVSEs in mainland Spain or the Balearic Islands with connector type/power and session start time known. Connector-specific/promotional prices shown in the app override the standard table; Canary Islands, partner/roaming EVSEs and unresolved exceptions remain fail-closed. Subscription tariffs are stored separately and only apply when selected.

inventoryNote: The 20-CPO named inventory is a priority shortlist, not the complete national denominator. REVE reported 189 charging infrastructure operators contacted for integration in April 2025; that figure remains the provisional official baseline only until the current live CPO inventory is recovered. Seven named operators are explicitly set aside; five named operators remain active and must be investigated before expanding the shortlist or when the live inventory becomes available.
method: A CPO is counted treated only when an exact non-extrapolated tariff source has been made usable for at least a validated subset and all unresolved rows are explicitly fail-closed. A CPO is set aside only after official site/map, indexed public web/API/QR surfaces and useful third-party station services have been explored without obtaining a usable exact tariff source; mobile-app-only values are not inferred or reconstructed when they are not publicly exposed.
